slides.title: Before holiday baking, check the pantry. You own 3 open bags of flour.
Pull out the baking shelf
slides.body: Everything onto the counter. Seeing it all at once stops the duplicates.

slides.title: Group like with like
slides.body: All the sugar together. All the vanilla together. Surprise: there's three.

slides.title: Write what you have
slides.body: One quick list on paper. It lives on the fridge for the season.

slides.title: Then write what you need
slides.body: Shop from the gap, not from memory. Memory buys more cinnamon.

slides.title: Give baking one bin
slides.body: Everything for cookies in one bin you can pull out in one move.

slides.title: The pantry doesn't need to be pretty. It needs to be seen.
Want the lists ready to print?
slides.body: Grab the Tidy Brain Printable Pack for the pantry/fridge inventory and grocery list. Link in bio.
